text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED: sustained 429 spike for tenant 'novusbank' on pool dedicated-nyc-42. 12% of intents 429 over 3m. Paging oncall.

kal (oncall): ack. pulling live tail + pool telemetry.

kal (oncall): ingress shows a sharp migration burst from novusbank: ~48k rps, pool total 210k rps. 429 header: X-RateLimit-Reason=tenant_quota_exceeded. Looks contractual, not OOM.

ops-bot: pool dedicated-nyc-42 status: GPUs fully allocated (no spare), autoscale: disabled for dedicated commitments. avg queue=380. kv_cache_hit 81%.

sanjay: confirming — this tenant is on a bespoke cap: monthly_burst_tokens + short_burst_limit. They exhausted short_burst token bank.

emily (acct): NovusBank is mid-migration, they asked for temporary burst last week but we didn't approve higher baseline. They've just escalated to account team.

kal (oncall): two lanes: (A) temporary contract exception (requires approvals + billing note) -> instant; (B) isolate their traffic via ingress quarantine to carve guaranteed share for others. prefer B to protect multi-tenant SLA.

sanjay: we can program an ingress shard rule to rate-limit novusbank at L7 before it hits pool, and simultaneously enforce a fairshare carve. Doing both reduces cross-tenant impact and buys time.

kal (oncall): go ahead with ingress rule. paste the command you'll run.

sanjay: ```
# ingress quarantine: drop/shape beyond sustained 35k rps for novusbank, tag traffic
/infra/ingress rule create --pool dedicated-nyc-42 --match-tenant novusbank --action shape --sustained 35000 --burst 50000 --tag quarantine-novus-2898

# apply fairshare carve for 15m
/infra/fairshare apply --pool dedicated-nyc-42 --tenant novusbank --guarantee 0.40 --ttl 15m
```

kal (oncall): applied both. monitoring.

ops-bot: ingress rule active: quarantine-novus-2898. fairshare cookie set. queue depth dropping.

kal (oncall): immediate effect: non-novus 429s dropped to 0.3%. novusbank still seeing internal 429s but within quarantine/burst window.

sales-zoe: I notified NovusBank account lead: said they can pause migration burst for 30m if we need. Also requested cost estimate for 2h burst override.

product-ela: note — KV cache warming cost if we move them to other pool. prefer L7 shaping over cross-region reroute.

emily (acct): OK to start emergency override workflow if customer insists. Legal/finance approval time: 25-40m typical.

kal (oncall): handoff: I'm monitoring next 20m, then need 20m break. infra-bot will alert on >1% cross-tenant 429. If stable, keep carve until we close.

sanjay: logs showing headers now include X-Ingress-Quarantine: true and X-FairShare-Guard: true. sample:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Reason: tenant_quota_exceeded
X-Ingress-Quarantine: true
X-FairShare-Guard: true
{"tenant":"novusbank","usage":81200,"burst_remaining":0}
```

infra-bot: incident record created: INC-2898765432. Audit token created for ingress rule change. Override ticket OR-00085 pre-created (pending approvals).

kal (oncall): customers receiving 429s have been sent a templated support note by sales-zoe. good to coordinate billing note if we override.

sales-zoe: customer replied: "we urgently need full throughput for next 90m — can you provide temporary increase?" Asking legal for expedited approval.

product-ela: action item: add automatic escrow burst for customers in migration window (feature request INFRA-FEAT-231). Noted in thread.

sanjay: 18m in: quarantine holding, non-novus error-rate stable. novusbank internal 429 rate dropped 60% after fairshare.

kal (oncall): suggest we gradually reduce carve from 40%->25% after 45m to reduce customer impact if metrics allow. Also prepare rollback steps.

sanjay: prepared rollback cmd:
```
/infra/fairshare remove --pool dedicated-nyc-42 --tenant novusbank
/infra/ingress rule delete --id quarantine-novus-2898
```

emily (acct): legal signaled conditional yes if customer signs an addendum and pre-authorizes billing delta. They want written customer consent.

sales-zoe: got written consent from NovusBank. Uploading to OR-00085 and requesting finance sign-off.

ops-bot: OR-00085 status: pending-approvals (need sales-zoe + finance-team). Once applied, override will attach billing note and TTL.

kal (oncall): 46m since mitigation: metrics look stable. I'll lower carve now to 25% for 20m and watch.

sanjay: executing:
```
/infra/fairshare update --pool dedicated-nyc-42 --tenant novusbank --guarantee 0.25 --ttl 20m
```

ops-bot: fairshare updated. monitoring shows slight increase in novusbank 429s but aggregate SLA for top-tier endpoints remains <1%.

kal (oncall): handoff: now leaving to infra-bot alerts and product-ela for follow-ups. infra-bot to notify me if cross-tenant 429>0.75%.

infra-bot: noted. will page kal if threshold crossed. INC-2898765432 mitigation: ingress quarantine + fairshare carve. OR-00085 waiting approvals.

product-ela: logging follow-ups: (1) contract language clarity, (2) migration-friendly burst workflow, (3) automation to propose fairshare when bespoke quotas hit. Assign INFRA-13155.

emily (acct): closing loop with account: customer opted for scheduled upgrade next week. They accepted temporary shaping and signed addendum for future burst.

kal (oncall): closing incident thread. Keep INFRA-13155 and OR-00085 open until retro and billing confirmed. Good job team. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INC-2898765432 status: resolved (mitigation in place).
